[播放《日本七日记》配乐试听（10:38，含 9 个章节）](<./attachments/audition.m4a>)

**9 首都找到了，你不用再下载。** 我按现有视频的时间码排了这版歌单，每次换曲用 2 秒交叉淡化。

| 成片时间 | 画面 | 播放曲目 |
|---|---|---|
| 0:00–0:50 | 深圳出发，经广州飞往关西 | **旅立ちの小径** — Falcom Sound Team jdk，用你发来的《空之轨迹 the 1st》版 |
| 0:50–2:28 | 新今宫、心斋桥、大阪环球影城 | **Off to Osaka** — Kevin MacLeod |
| 2:28–4:43 | 道顿堀、梅田，到京都逛街 | **Bossa Antigua** — Kevin MacLeod |
| **4:43–5:52** | **宇治桥、平等院、宇治川、大吉山** | **愛を見つけた場所 (Last Ver.)** — 黄前久美子、高坂丽奈，用你桌面上《京吹》第三季的版本 |
| 5:52–6:58 | 岚山寺院、竹林、龟冈，去京都站换车 | **街は川と共に生きる** — 西木康智，《八方旅人》 |
| **6:58–8:08** | **新干线抵达东京，新宿、池袋 Animate** | **K&A 初訪問** — RADWIMPS，《天气之子》 |
| 8:08–8:58 | 秋叶原 RADIO 会馆、回酒店休息、浅草寺 | **Every Day Is Night** — Garoad，《VA-11 HALL-A》 |
| **8:58–9:24** | **晚上回秋叶原，逛 TRADER、淘中古游戏** | **ILLEXECUTION Inst.ver** —《HENPRI》原声伴奏版 |
| 9:24–10:38 | 成田机场、澳门、珠海，回深圳及片尾 | **Airport Lounge** — Kevin MacLeod，片尾最后 4 秒淡出 |

我最想留下的是 **5:28 的大吉山**和 **8:58 的秋叶原二刷**。前者让宇治川一路延续的京吹合奏陪你登顶；后者等你回到买《HENPRI》的那条街，才让游戏自己的主题响起来。

这份是本地试听。正式放上公开博客时，Falcom 有明确的个人影像使用规则；《京吹》等商业原版录音仍需确认配片许可，片尾署名本身不能代替授权。[Falcom 使用示例](https://www.falcom.co.jp/music-use/case) · [《京吹》发行方音源使用窗口](https://www.bandainamcomusiclive.co.jp/contact/)

[播放本地试听版](./attachments/japan-2025-audition.mp4) · [从宇治 4:43 开始听](./attachments/japan-2025-audition.mp4#t=283) · [打开 MP4 文件](<./attachments/japan-2025-audition.mp4>)

九首配乐已经合进 **10 分 38 秒的 1080p 视频**，片尾也换成了对应曲目。可以重点听 [6:58 新干线抵达东京时的《K&A 初訪問》](./attachments/japan-2025-audition.mp4#t=418)，以及 [8:58 秋叶原二刷时的《ILLEXECUTION》](./attachments/japan-2025-audition.mp4#t=538)。

**你理解得对，博客直接用 Hyoban 的 `@hyoban/trip-map` 组件。** 我核对了线上文章：游记用 `iframe` 嵌入站内的行程页。读者点「回放」时，组件读取路线坐标、站点和照片，在 Mapbox 地图上实时移动镜头，所以可以暂停、跳站、点开照片。宇治段落里的 Spotify 歌单是另一个独立播放器。[线上游记](https://niracler.com/2510/)

**这次只生成了本地 MP4。** 它把地图画面和九首歌按时间固定下来，拖到 4:43 就会听到京吹。博客组件只播放网页里配置的音轨，不会自动读取你电脑上的视频或配乐。

AGENTS.md
# Repository Guidelines

## Project Structure & Module Organization

- `src/pages/` stores routes; `src/layouts/` shares shells; `src/components/` holds reusable UI (Header, Footer, BaseHead, CommentSection).
- Content lives in `src/content/` with `content.config.ts` validating frontmatter; prefer kebab-case slugs. Shared assets go in `public/`; `dist/` is build output and untracked.
- Styling sits in `src/styles/` (tokens + Tailwind layers); utilities/scripts in `src/utils/`, `src/types/`, and `src/scripts/`; site metadata in `src/consts.ts`.
- `tailwind.config.mjs` maps CSS variables to utilities; `remark-modified-time.mjs` refreshes post metadata when needed.

## Setup, Build, and Development Commands

- Install: `pnpm install`. Dev server: `pnpm dev`.
- Build: `pnpm build`; local preview: `pnpm preview`.
- Quality: `pnpm lint` (Biome) + `pnpm format`; use `pnpm astro check` when adding TS/MDX.
- Lockfile: `node scripts/check-lockfile.mjs` validates frozen installs in a clean temporary workspace.
- Design render check: `node scripts/check-design-rendering.mjs` (or `pnpm check:design` when pnpm is healthy).

## Local Development Notes

- Prefer scripts for repeatable local checks instead of manual workaround notes. `scripts/check-design-rendering.mjs` starts Astro when needed, uses `/design` without a trailing slash, and verifies GFM tables/footnotes.
- If pnpm 11 rewrites a large `pnpm-lock.yaml` during an unrelated task, treat it as dependency-tooling churn and keep it out of the change unless the task is explicitly about dependency maintenance.

## Coding Style & Naming Conventions

- Biome enforces 4-space indentation, line width 100, double quotes, and organized imports; run format before pushing.
- Keep Biome Markdown and YAML formatting disabled: Markdown uses the existing `markdownlint-cli2` staged-file checks, while workflow YAML and generated pnpm lockfiles retain their existing formatting. Do not mass-reformat content/frontmatter when updating Biome.
- Naming: PascalCase for components/layouts, kebab-case for content slugs and utilities, clear filenames. Favor semantic Tailwind tokens (`text-secondary`, `bg-surface`) over raw values.
- Keep Astro/TS lean: derive props from data, prune unused imports/variables.

## Testing Guidelines

- Lightweight Node regression tests live under `tests/`; run targeted tests with `node --test tests/<name>.test.mjs`. Playwright is available if you add browser specs. Name them `*.spec.ts` under `tests/` and keep headless-friendly.
- For UI or script changes, at minimum run `pnpm build` then `pnpm preview` and interact with scripts in `src/scripts/`.

## Development Workflow

- **Branch naming**: `feature/...`, `fix/...`, `docs/...`, `refactor/...`, `test/...`.
- **Commit format** (Conventional, <72 chars): `type(scope): concise summary`. Types: `feat`, `fix`, `refactor`, `docs`, `test`, `chore`. Optional body: up to 3–4 bullets focused on impact; imperative mood; omit obvious diffs. No AI/co-author markers.
- **PR process**: branch from `main`, open a PR with intent + test plan, update docs when needed, prefer squash-and-merge. Include before/after screenshots for visual work; note config/env changes.

## Release & Changelog

- When releasing, bump `package.json` version and keep a `CHANGELOG.md` using Keep a Changelog sections (Added, Fixed, Technical) with issue refs or short hashes.
- Commit release as `chore(release): bump version to x.y.z`, tag `v{x.y.z}`, and align GitHub release notes with the changelog. Follow semantic versioning.

## Design Reference

- **Agent design spec**: `DESIGN.md` (root) — standardized 9-section format with all tokens, components, and usage guidelines. Read this first for any visual/styling work.
- **Human design doc**: `src/content/blog/zh/design.mdx` — narrative design system article following Apple HIG structure.
- **Token source of truth**: `src/styles/tokens.css` — all CSS variables defined here.
- Card components use `.surface-card` and its variants (`--soft`, `--flat`, `--compact`, `--hover-border`, `--hover-none`) defined in `src/styles/global.css`.
- Hover effects should use color/border changes only; avoid `translateY` lift animations.

## Pre-commit Hooks

- `check-font-coverage.py`: validates font subsetting
- `astro check`: TypeScript/MDX type checking
- `lint-staged`: Biome formatting and linting
- `check-token-consistency.mjs`: **runs only when `tokens.css` is staged** — verifies that hardcoded hex values in `DESIGN.md`, showcase components (`src/components/design/*.astro`), and `design.mdx` match `tokens.css`. If it fails, update the stale values before committing.

## Configuration & Security Notes

- Public environment variables: `PUBLIC_TURNSTILE_SITE_KEY`; secrets: `TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY`, `ADMIN_TOKEN`; set via `.env`/`.dev.vars`/deployment secrets (only `PUBLIC_` values reach the client).


#### Guidance

Place each visual next to the short text it supports. Keep only the calls, files, props, states, and boundaries needed to answer the user's current question or the options to resolve the current discussion point.

You may use one of these, you may use several, it is unlikely you will use all of them. Use your judgement and don't overwhelm the user.

### Evidence

Concrete evidence that the change works. Show a before and after.

Screenshots are S-tier - when the environment is set up for it and the change is visual.

Execution-based evidence is A-tier. Test results, console output. Show the exact test that now fails and passes, using pseudocode.

### Merge Danger

Describe whether it's a one-way or two-way door. You can walk back through two-way doors, but not one-way doors. A PR that is cheap to roll back is lower risk. Changes that involve destructive actions or hard-to-reverse decisions are one-way doors.

The blast radius is the potential impact or scope of the changes introduced by this PR. Consider all possibilities. Examples are layout shift, breakages for consumers, mobile responsiveness, etc.

items.input:
text(await tools.exec_command({cmd:`cat > pr.md <<'EOF'
## Summary

《日本七日记》的地图回放现在从 9 月 27 日深圳出发，连续播放到 10 月 7 日返回深圳。时间线补入 12 个停靠点和换乘点，保留原有 46 站的回放链接和 169 张照片的顺序。

- 京都到东京沿东海道新干线绘制。东京市内使用地铁线路，京都补上市巴士，车站与景点之间沿步行路网连接。
- 返程依次经过上野换乘、成田机场、澳门国际机场、银河、关闸和拱北，再乘客车经深中通道到深圳西丽。缺少乘车记录的线路在卡片中标为「推定」。
- 铁路、巴士和道路坐标随行程发布，回放时直接读取。地图卡片显示每段的交通方式和换乘说明。

## Evidence

**Before**　线上回放的成田卡片只有候机记录，东京到机场显示为两点连线。

![原版成田机场回放](./before.jpg)

**After**　从京成上野到成田的回放沿铁路前进，卡片说明京成本线为推定线路。

![新版东京到成田的铁路回放](./rail-preview-3.jpg)

- 在独立检出上通过冻结锁文件安装、锁文件检查及 \`pnpm check:ci\`，共 72 项测试通过。
- 对比线上行程数据，原有站点和照片顺序一致。100 段起终点不同的地面移动均有沿途坐标。
- 在桌面浏览器从东京逐站回放到西丽，打开成田站点的全尺寸照片。390px 宽度下，从游记内嵌的时间线可直接跳到成田回放。

## Merge Danger

**Door**　可回滚。还原提交即可恢复上一版地图。

**Blast Radius**　日本游记的时间线、地点页和地图回放。随仓库分发的播放器补丁增加巴士和步行接驳图标；冻结安装已验证。
EOF

items.text:
点位和线路已推到 [PR #108](https://github.com/niracler/bokushi/pull/108)，**6 项 GitHub 检查全部通过，等待合并**。

回放从 **46 站补到 58 站**，覆盖深圳出发、京都到东京的新干线、东京都内地铁、去成田机场的铁路，以及经澳门、珠海坐客车回深圳。100 段地面移动都有沿途坐标，推定线路已在卡片上标明。原有 169 张照片的顺序和回放链接均已核对。

这次提交只包含行程和播放器改动，配乐和试听 MP4 都留在本地。

MEMORY.md:47-47|note=[确认既有播放器和已合并的前置工作]

[附图]
我先测 Telegram 这笔上传的实际速度，再看它走的是直连还是代理。测速会尽量利用正在传的视频，避免另起一个大上传抢带宽。

Use when the user asks to export a Raw Log into a Replay, curate `session.json`, select and label `.webp` Frames, review packaged Attachments or Deliverables, write a title and opening description, or redact residual sensitive details before publishing. --- # Encore — Session Replay & Curation Skill Encore turns a Raw Log from **Codex**, **Claude Code**, **Claude.ai**, or **WorkBuddy** into a portable **Replay** rendered by the standalone **Player** (**Left**: Turns, Tool calls, Sub-agents, Attachments, Deliverables, and Frames; **Right**: live Context Snapshot inspector and Compaction boundaries; **Bottom**: Step timeline). While `npx @niracler/encore@latest` builds an immediately playable Replay, this skill guides **Curation** before publishing. --- ## Workflow ### 1. Export the Initial Replay - If the user has not specified a Raw Log yet, list recent local sessions: ```bash npx @niracler/encore@latest --list ``` - Export the target Raw Log into an explicit Replay directory with `-o` so it is saved outside the default temporary preview directory, without blocking on the preview server (pass `--asset-root ` if referenced Attachments or Deliverables live outside the current working directory and native session workspace): ```bash npx @niracler/encore@latest -o ./replays/ --no-serve ``` - Output files: - `session.json` — canonical **Session** data (`title`, `description`, `initialContext`, `deliverables`, `frames`, `items`) - `*.webp` — deduplicated embedded **Frames** extracted from the Raw Log - `attachments/` — collected **Attachments** and **Deliverables** within allowed **Asset Roots**, plus generated PDF/XLSX previews when applicable - `index.html`, `encore-player.js`, `encore-player.css` — standalone **Player** (`
`) --- ### 2. Curate & Label Frames (`frames[]`) Raw exports often contain 15–40 Frames, including terminal errors, minor tweaks, or duplicate views. 1. **Inspect every image**: Use `view_image` (or `Read`) to visually inspect each `.webp` file listed in `session.json -> frames`. 2. **Keep key milestones**: Remove broken renders, repetitive micro-adjustments, or uninformative entries from `session.json -> frames`. Keep **3 to 12 milestone Frames** showing progression from reference to final result. 3. **Write concrete labels**: Replace fallback labels (`过程画面 #1` / `Agent Frame #1`) with concrete 6–16 character labels stating what changed: - Good: `"第一张草图：信息过载"`, `"V2：改为深色双栏网格"`, `"终稿：定版课程海报"` - Bad: `"图片 1"`, `"修改后"`, `"赋能视觉升级版"` --- ### 3. Write Title & Opening Description (`title` & `description`) Edit the top-level `title` and `description` in `session.json`: 1. **`title` (8–24 chars)**: - State the concrete task, turning point, or friction directly. - Good: `"嫌太难看，重新设计七阶段图"`, `"把内部播放器拆成开源工具 Encore"`, `"排查 Mesh 40940 冲突并补齐测试"` - Skip empty buzzwords (`赋能`, `深度剖析`, `全方位重构`, `探索与实践`, `基于 AI 的…`). 2. **`description` (1–3 sentences, 40–120 chars)**: - Shown in the **Player** before the viewer clicks **Play**. - State **what problem the Session tackled**, **what key pivot or Sub-agent collaboration happened**, and **what Deliverable or outcome was reached**. - Write plain, direct prose without repeating the title. --- ### 4. Redaction, Packaged Files, & Turn Trimming Automatic **Redaction** rewrites `session.json` to hide home paths (`~`), API keys (`[密钥]`), emails (`[邮箱]`), and private IPs (`[内网地址]`), and prints non-blocking **Leak Check** warnings. 1. **Review Leak Check warnings**: Inspect every path reported under `Leak check found ... potential sensitive snippet(s)`. 2. **Redact residual sensitive details in `initialContext` and `items[]`**: Regex cannot catch internal codenames, colleague names, intranet hostnames, or business figures. Inspect `initialContext.mem`, `initialContext.sys`, `items[type="compact"].text`, and `items[]`, replacing sensitive passages with a clear marker such as `（涉及内部业务细节，已略去）` or `(Internal context redacted)`. 3. **Inspect packaged Attachments and Deliverables (`attachments/`)**: Automatic Redaction only rewrites `session.json`; it does not modify packaged PDFs, spreadsheets, images, or videos. Verify each collected file before publishing, and remove or replace any file that contains private data. 4. **Trim off-topic Turns**: If the Raw Log starts or ends with an unrelated topic, either re-export with `--from --to ` or remove those Events from `session.json -> items`. --- ### 5. Rebuild & Verify - Because `index.html` loads `./session.json` at runtime, edits to `session.json` appear immediately on browser refresh. - Run a **Rebuild** after editing `session.json` so Encore refreshes Player assets, syncs ``, refreshes attachment previews, drops references to deleted Frames, and re-runs the **Leak Check** without re-importing the Raw Log or overwriting Curation edits: ```bash npx @niracler/encore@latest ./replays/<slug> --no-serve ``` - Launch a local preview for the user: ```bash npx @niracler/encore@latest play ./replays/<slug> ``` "}

**[发给朋友的单文件 Demo：把日本游记做成能回放的地图](<./attachments/curated.html>)** · [在本机预览](http://localhost:4187/)

用 Encore 0.3.0 导出后，剪成了 **32 步、8 张过程图**。朋友可以一路看到：第一轮怎么从 Apple「照片」挑出 54 张，你为什么想换掉第一版地图，以及一句「不应该拿直线」怎样让东京地铁和成田机场铁路重新画了一遍。最后是 10 分 38 秒的配乐成片和 PR 合并。

**直接发上面的 HTML 文件就行**，约 1.1 MB。我验证了断网后也能播放、跳步和看图。分享版已去掉账单地址、凭据、私人路径、原始票据和 Telegram 排查内容。[可继续剪辑的 Encore 工程](<~/Documents/Codex/Encore/日本游记地图回放/replay>)
